reviewer: main coordinator; full reader/writer and attachment registration inspected
counting: Two distinct owners; wrappers, individual fields and child dispatch do not multiply count.

rows.coordinator_observation: Persistent attachment creates ServerPlayerDataManager bound to actual ServerPlayer. PartialNbtSerializable.deserializeNBT delegates load(...,false), proving disk bridge. Stats.load iterates existing registered skill/resource owners, loads only keys present, preserving newly registered defaults. Full skill reader resets level/xp then restores optional cycle/level/xp and abilities keyed by original unique identifier; absent ability entry recalculates deactivation, not awarding an unlock. Outer manager checks legitimacy hash AFTER reading; missing/mismatched hash revokes legitimacy, not erasing earned skill counters. Paired saves use saveToNbt for disk versus getSyncData for client.
rows.application_limit: Borrow owner binding and present-only known-key import; Dynasty is Forge1.20.1, not this NeoForge HolderLookup API. getInt/getFloat lack strict numeric type guards and loaded ranges are not clamped. Whole Stats/skill/ability dispatch is ONE implementation credit; no extra credits per skill, field, wrapper or hash branch.

rows.coordinator_observation: Storage.load independently restores ItemStorage, PortalMap, Checkpoint and PatchouliBooks from the real attachment disk chain. Typed compound guards; nonempty ItemStorage/PortalMap clear and reconstruct per entry, invalid entries logged and skipped independently. Full ItemStacks retain actual payload; portal target key plus source dimension and position reconstructed together, missing BlockPos defaults actual shared spawn. Books clear on present list and parse valid registry identifiers; needsPatchouliSync set. Writer skips durable inventory/portal/checkpoint only when partial client sync, writes them in disk=false route. Existing initialized books remain when absent.
rows.application_limit: Borrow independently owned durable stores and isolated malformed-entry handling. Empty compound does NOT clear old item/portal maps because of !isEmpty guard, checkpoint numeric getters may silently default, inventory keys not range validated here. Clone uses putAll and shallow item references; do not copy that pattern for Dynasty. This owner is distinct from Stats, but four child stores and per-entry loop are ONE credit.

rows.coordinator_observation: ClientPlayerDataManager.loadFromNbt reconstructs skill/resource client instances, refreshes UI listeners and lore books from server sync. Actual durable attachment owner is ServerPlayerDataManager, and this client mirror cannot establish permanent old-world or death recovery.
rows.application_limit: No migration credit. No additional credit for shape similarity to server load.
